name: aoe2-lsp
description: Language server support for Age of Empires II random map scripts (.rms) and XS (.xs), powered by the aoe2-lsp binary.

aoe2lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Optional override: explicit path to an `aoe2-lsp` binary. An explicitly set value wins over auto-resolution and disables network downloads. The default (`aoe2-lsp`) is not an override — it falls through to the version cache, then PATH, then (with `#aoe2lsp.download.mode#` `auto`) a GitHub Releases download. Build it from the aoe-rms-lsp repository (`go build ./cmd/aoe2-lsp`) or install a release binary.

aoe2lsp.download.mode.markdownDescription: `auto`: resolve the server as explicit `#aoe2lsp.serverPath#` → cached version in the extension's global storage → PATH → download from GitHub Releases (latest release, SHA256-verified against `SHA256SUMS`, extracted with the system `tar`). `off`: no network access at all — cache → PATH only.

aoe2lsp.diagnostics.severityOverrides.markdownDescription: Maps a diagnostic code (`unknown-command`, `undefined-symbol`, `deprecated-effect-percent`, ...) to a severity: `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint` or `none` (suppresses the diagnostic).

aoe2lsp.includeRoots.markdownDescription: Extra absolute directories searched (in order, after the including file's directory) when resolving `#include` / `#includeXS`. Point it at the game's `ai-rms` folder to resolve stock includes.
